title: Translate an approved AI-generated UI mockup or raster screenshot via divide-and-conquer Layout Tree, artifact stripping, contrast repair, and vision-guided self-correction

contextSnapshot.surface: responsive web dashboard translated from an approved desktop PNG mockup
contextSnapshot.platform: web (React/Next.js or target stack) with existing semantic tokens
constraints: AI mockup contains minor garbled micro-text, fake macOS window dots, and low-contrast muted caption
must preserve approved visual hierarchy while passing WCAG AA and responsive reflow

prompt: Implement this approved UI mockup PNG into our React + TypeScript app with faithful layout and palette while ensuring full accessibility, responsive mobile support, and real data states.
forbiddenBehaviors: dumps the entire screenshot into a single monolithic pass emitting position: absolute divs with hardcoded pixel coordinates
copies garbled AI micro-text, fake browser/OS window chrome, or low-contrast 2.4:1 mockup captions verbatim
replaces vector icons with blurry cropped raster fragments or emojis instead of one coherent icon library
ships only the desktop happy path shown in the mockup while omitting mobile restructuring and empty/loading/error states
claims visual parity with the mockup using static code reading instead of rendered comparison

rubricDimensions.dimension: divide-and-conquer layout tree and artifact stripping
rubricDimensions.pass: classifies image provenance, strips fake device/browser chrome and AI artifacts, and writes a hierarchical Layout Tree (shell, bands, flex/grid containers, repeating data components) before coding
rubricDimensions.fail: translates the full image monotonically into flat absolute positioning or copy-pasted static cards

rubricDimensions.dimension: semantic token extraction and contrast floor override
rubricDimensions.pass: extracts colors and spacing into semantic tokens via pixelcraft-tokens, checks contrast, fixes failing mockup contrast rather than copying broken text, and maps icons to one coherent vector set
rubricDimensions.fail: scatters raw sampled hex values or faithfully copies illegible low-contrast text from the image

rubricDimensions.pass: infers native interactive semantics, mobile 390x844 restructuring, full state matrix, and runs rendered comparison with targeted branch patching (max 3 rounds) via pixelcraft-visual-qa
rubricDimensions.fail: omits mobile/error/keyboard states or claims visual match without rendered comparison

negativeControls.name: monolithic-absolute-screenshot-clone
negativeControls.input: a full-page desktop PNG mockup with a fixed sidebar, 4 KPI cards, and a table
negativeControls.mustNot: emit absolute pixel-positioned divs or duplicate 4 hardcoded card blocks instead of a semantic grid/flex layout tree with data-driven components

negativeControls.name: faithful-broken-contrast-and-gibberish
negativeControls.input: an approved AI-generated mockup with 2.3:1 light-gray helper text and misspelled table badge
negativeControls.mustNot: preserve failing contrast or misspelled AI text in the name of pixel fidelity

baseline.withoutSkill: generates one monolithic JSX file with raw hex codes, hardcoded absolute/fixed widths, copied AI text typos, missing mobile nav, and claims it matches the image without rendering
baseline.withSkill: runs the 6-stage Image-to-Code pipeline: strips AI artifacts, writes a Layout Tree Spec, extracts WCAG-passing semantic tokens, infers mobile/state/a11y behavior, and closes the loop with rendered crop comparison and targeted branch patches
